# HQX — Happiness Samurai

> Executive well-being, behavioral neuroscience, and eudaimonic leadership architecture founded by Manny Anchan. Energizing 100,000+ leaders across 40+ enterprise titans, 16 Indian states, and 9 nations.

- [Why HQX](https://hqx.co/why-hqx): Four pillars of distinction, measurable enterprise ROI, and organizational transformation.
